home.statementTitle: Architecture, interiors and custom furniture — designed and built across Bangladesh.
home.statementBody: Home Inn designs buildings and the spaces inside them. Since 2015 it has built and fitted out corporate offices, banks, resorts, showrooms and homes, working under the trade license of M/S Ahasan Enterprise.
home.statementFigures: So far: <n>{corporate}</n> corporate projects and <n>{residential}</n> residential ones, across <n>{districts}</n> districts of Bangladesh.
home.servicesTitle: How we take a space from the first drawing to handover.
home.areasTitle: Every kind of project, finished to the same standard.
home.trackRecordBody: Corporate offices, banks, government departments, hospitals and homes — delivered and handed over.
home.processTitle: From the first line to the finished view.
home.processPlanBody: Measured floor plans: every room, wall and door, and the way you move between them.
home.processPlanAlt: Ground-floor plan of a house, with rooms, furniture and a two-car garage
home.processModelBody: A design built up in 3D, so the massing and the light can be judged before anything is built.
home.processModelAlt: A 3D massing model of a modern duplex, with boxed balconies
home.processRenderBody: The same model rendered as it will look, close enough to decide on.
home.processRenderAlt: 3D render: the same duplex finished in white plaster and timber, at dusk
home.ctaBody: Send us the room, the budget range, and when you would like it finished. We will come back with what is possible.
